Package org.apache.rat.ui

Class UIOptionCollection<T extends UIOption<T>>

java.lang.Object
org.apache.rat.ui.UIOptionCollection<T>
Type Parameters:
T - the UIOption implementation.
Direct Known Subclasses:
CLIOptionCollection
public class UIOptionCollection<T extends UIOption<T>> extends Object
A collection of options supported by the UI. This includes RAT options and UI specific options.

    • rename

      public String rename(org.apache.commons.cli.Option option)
      Extracts the UI based name string for an option. The default implementation return the string returned by ArgumentTracker.extractKey(Option)
      Parameters:
      option - the option to create the name for.
      Returns:
      the name for the option in the UICollection name, may be the same as the option name.

    • getOptions

      public final org.apache.commons.cli.Options getOptions()
      Gets an Options that contains the Options and OptionGroups are understood by this collection. OptionGroups are registered in the resulting Options object.
      Returns:
      an Options that contains the Arg defined Option instances that are understood by this collection as well as any additional custom Options.
